codec_implementation: CoreELEC system FFmpeg Siren decoder; no FFmpeg code is bundled
why: The add-on shipped only an armv7l build of this wrapper, so CoreELEC 22 (aarch64 user space) reported a missing runtime when the CMCC remote was selected.

An ELF32 object cannot be loaded into an ELF64 process, and CoreELEC's aarch64 user space provides no 32-bit loader (/lib/ld-linux-armhf.so.3) and no 32-bit libc, so running the existing 32-bit library there is impossible.

The wrapper is rebuilt from the same source for aarch64 against the system FFmpeg 9 that CoreELEC 22 ships. Because it only calls libavcodec/libavutil, the produced object is ~50 KB and stays architecture-agnostic about the codec.
link_inputs: dl/box-ffmpeg/libavcodec.so.63 (copied off the target box; supplies DT_NEEDED only)
dl/box-ffmpeg/libavutil.so.61 (copied off the target box; supplies DT_NEEDED only)
verification: Loaded through ctypes on the box: create() succeeded, a real 40-byte frame returned 640 bytes of S16_LE with 320/320 non-zero samples, and all-zero / 0xf8+zero frames returned AVERROR_INVALIDDATA (-1094995529), which is the documented Siren behaviour. Symbol set matches the armv7l build.
